subject.title: fix: open selected channel setup immediately

question: Should explicit positional and `--channel` selection permanently bypass the generic confirmation and picker, changing the existing guided CLI interaction for current users?
rationale: The branch deliberately changes a documented behavior contract rather than repairing a source-defined malfunction, and source/tests alone cannot determine whether the new default is the intended product UX.

options.title: Preserve picker-first selection
options.body: Keep the selected channel highlighted in the existing guided picker flow and limit this PR to the exact-ID-over-alias correctness repair.

options.title: Approve immediate entry
options.body: Adopt direct channel setup as the public default for explicit selection and retain the updated docs, ordered flow coverage, and Back-to-picker recovery behavior.
